In this paper, we argue the importance of generating long-form answers to ambiguous factoid questions. In that, we present ASQA (Answer Summaries for Questions which are Ambiguous)—a novel dataset that pairs each ambiguous question from AMBIGQA with a crowdsourced long-form answer.
